depiction.primary_object: rounded pill or oval outline containing a checkmark
modifiers: plus sign in bottom right corner
depiction.composition: single outline shape with centered checkmark and lower-right badge

readings.meaning: add a task or to-do item
approve or sign off on a request

ambiguity: It looks very similar to standard checkbox-plus, circle-check-plus, or badge-check icons, and as a task icon inside a to-do app it is self-referential UI chrome rather than a distinct real-world subject.

modifier_semantics.meaning: completed, verified, approved, or task item
